An '''anti-grav ball''' was a piece of sporting equipment. It was used in the sport known as [[trophy chase]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalos IV]]. Competitors used [[repulsor-stick]]s to guide an anti-grav ball through [[target-ring]]s suspended from stable [[neph]]s.<ref name="E">{{WEGCite|story=Elusive (adventure)|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
